ns2:section.sectionText: This course will meet in 3015 BIF. This course is designed to provide doctoral students an introduction to recent research issues and challenges in Information Systems (IS) with a focus on digital platforms. This course offers exposition on how research problems are formulated and refined to a working definition, and how actual research is conducted and reported. This course aims to help you transition from a consumer of research to an active researcher and a contributor of insight. Besides examining the research themes important to the IS field, we discuss many issues affecting the research process including research rigor versus relevance, writing, submitting, and presenting papers. We will achieve the course objectives through individual reading of papers, class discussions and thorough work on a research paper. By the end of the semester, each student is also expected to be able to formulate a research question and develop a research paper or proposal.
